description: VENUS labware type -> how decks build it. The VENUS type is a definition's file name without extension (ML_STAR\STF_L.rck -> STF_L); `venus` is that definition in VENUS's library (config/Labware). `factory` is the matching PyLabRobot factory, if PyLabRobot has one. `build` says which geometry decks use: "plr" (PyLabRobot's factory) or "venus" (built from the VENUS definition by pipeline/venus_labware.py). VENUS's definitions are what the lab's runs on this STARlet use, so they are the reference: a type is built from PyLabRobot only while PyLabRobot's factory matches VENUS's within 0.15 mm, which pipeline/venus_labware.check_map verifies when this file loads. Tip racks stay "plr": a .rck holds the rack, not the tip PyLabRobot needs to pipette. Add a type with its VENUS file and let check_map tell you whether PyLabRobot agrees.

ignore.note: Fixed parts of the instrument (config/ML_Starlet.tpl: waste block, teaching needles, verification blocks, 96 head slide waste). PyLabRobot's deck already has the tip waste; pipeline/instrument.py checks it and the 96 head's eject position against the template.

PLT_CAR_L5_DWP.note: PyLabRobot's sites are 0.8-0.9 mm further front and 0.33 mm higher than VENUS's (checked 2026-11-12), so decks use VENUS's.

STF_L.note: Hamilton 300 uL standard-volume filter tips. Footprint and A1 match VENUS.

ST_L.note: Hamilton 300 uL standard-volume tips, no filter. Footprint and A1 match VENUS (checked 2026-11-12).

HTF_L.note: Hamilton 1000 uL high-volume filter tips. Footprint and A1 match VENUS (checked 2026-11-12).

HT_L.note: Hamilton 1000 uL high-volume tips, no filter. Footprint and A1 match VENUS (checked 2026-11-12).

LTF_L.note: Hamilton 10 uL low-volume filter tips. Footprint and A1 match VENUS (checked 2026-11-12).

LT_L.note: Hamilton 10 uL low-volume tips, no filter. Footprint and A1 match VENUS (checked 2026-11-12).

TIP_50ulF_L.note: Hamilton 50 uL filter tips. Footprint and A1 match VENUS (checked 2026-11-12).

Cos_96_PCR.note: Corning Costar 96-well PCR plate. PyLabRobot 0.2.2 has no definition; built from VENUS's (127 x 86 x 22.5 mm, wells 20.5 mm deep, 289.7 uL by VENUS's volume equations).
